description: Returns the full build prompt for one template as Markdown (title, description, stack, then the prompt), ready to follow in the current project. Use this when the user has chosen a template and you will build it yourself; use open_in_builder instead to hand the prompt to Lovable, v0 or Bolt, and get_template for details without the prompt. Free templates work on any signed-in account. A Pro template is included with Pro and Lifetime; on other plans the first fetch spends one Prompt Pack credit and later fetches of that slug are free, and an account with no credits gets an error with the pack link. New Pro prompts also have a fair-use cap per account (20 per 10 minutes, 60 a day, 200 a week, shared with open_in_builder) that never blocks a prompt already opened today. Free-plan accounts may get a short upgrade note as a second text block.

slug.description: Template slug, exactly as returned by search (lowercase, hyphenated). An unknown slug returns an error.
